{{dablink|For other uses of the words "silver" and "road," see [[Silver]] and [[Road]].}}
The '''Silver Road''' is a major highway linking the city of [[Illian]] to [[Lugard]], the capital of [[Murandy]]. The road is sheltered from the [[cemaros]] by the [[Nemarellin Mountains]] that line the coast to the west. The road meets the [[Illian Road]] in the north, near the [[Manetherendrelle|River Manetherendrelle]].

The Causeway of the Northern Star carries the road into the capital of Illian.
